caption: The drawing depicts a single pitcher placed on a rectangular surface that appears to be a flat platform or mat. The pitcher has a rounded body that narrows near the neck and expands again near the rim, with a distinct curving handle attached and a wide, flared spout. The body and handle of the pitcher are rendered in shades of gray, suggesting the object is made of metal, while the inner surface of the pitcher is colored in a warm golden-yellow tone. The entire composition is centrally placed on a plain, beige or off-white background. There are shadows in gray tones indicating the pitcher’s placement on the surface. In the lower right corner, there is neat cursive writing, possibly notes or a description related to the pitcher, written in pencil or graphite.
title: Silver Pitcher
